scope: Static analysis only; no emulator run. Runtime members from tools/behavior.py, calls from recovered caller sources, vector offsets from decoded glue, hardware from instruction ledger. Source-level argument and result-use observations are C call-site records; compiler-lowered helpers and indirect/runtime-only calls are identified separately.

proof_categories.reconstructed ASM: machine-checked non-C assembly; no original-source provenance
proof_categories.behaviorally reconstructed: behavior evidence only; never a match
proof_categories.unresolved: no accepted source proof or meaning not established

waits.tick: G_h01_B1EC increments per VBlank. resident_F_4F40 waits until G_h01_B396 differs, then copies the tick; accepted caller is teardown resident_F_53E6, so do not claim it is the whole game loop.
waits.beam_sample: resident_F_4676 reads VPOSR, adds tick and stores G_h01_3AB8; no accepted C consumer for that word was found, so further purpose unresolved.
waits.completion: Gameplay busy-polls audio/global completion state (game_run_adventure tests G_h01_2A16); preserve the frame on which the wait releases.
waits.cia_timers: No absolute CIA timer access found. $BFE0FE is a CIAA PRA input alias.
